setting.title: Algorithm that searches for an operator. We search for a user (specified as an operator) who is online or has been online for the last 30 minutes. Priority is given to those who have the fewest channels in the last 24 hours and those who are not currently busy. If these two conditions are not met, the algorithm will return the most suitable option
setting.help: If enabled, only one operator will be added according to this algorithm. If disabled, all operators will be added to the new channel.

setting.title: Add new operators to old channels in bot
setting.help: When a new operator is added to the bot, should they be added to other (already created) channels associated with this bot?
